text: Low-angle view of a bench setup. Centre-left: a black plastic rack or holder with slotted openings, one of which holds an upright clear tube capped with an orange screw cap; the tube contains a red/pink liquid filling the visible upper portion. Adjacent rack slots appear empty, with a dark circular insert visible beside the tube. Behind the rack, a white and magenta panel carries a black-and-white square fiducial/QR-style marker, with partial text "R..." to its right. At right, a vertical aluminium extrusion frame with bolt heads runs up the image; a black cable hangs down from an object at the top edge. Background is a plain pale wall and ceiling. White plastic pieces sit at bottom centre.
